release_name: Live TV v5.2 (Build 55) — Last Channel Toggle & History Recall Fix
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: ⇄ Last Channel Toggle & Recall Fix: The 'Last CH' toggle button now works flawlessly across macOS, Android, and Web, automatically resolving previous channels from persisted watch history even on fresh app launch
🔄 Seamless Alternating Flashback: Tapping 'Last CH' or pressing hotkey 'Q' continuously alternates back and forth between your current and previous channel with dynamic on-screen button labels
🔔 Enhanced Player OSD Toast: Channel swap notifications now render with top priority above player controls so you always know which channel is tuning
👆 Player Controls Touch & Scroll Lock: Touching, swiping, or horizontally scrolling through the top action pills and quick-switch channel carousel will NEVER prematurely hide the controls overlay
🎚️ Web Audio Lip-Sync Offset: Real-time delay compensation (-500ms to +1500ms)
🔍 In-Player Spotlight Channel Search (/): Instant modal HUD search across all 2,989+ channels without exiting fullscreen
🔔 Live Sports Match Reminders: Set alerts on upcoming matches with synthesized chime and 1-click tune
🔎 Custom Video Zoom & Pan: Multi-level zoom with touch pinch and drag-to-pan
↻ Stream Auto-Retry & Reconnect: 3-stage automatic stall recovery and instant reload
